name: The Crawl Price Index
description: Living observatory of the crawl economy. Free headline tier — full dataset requires subscription.

block_rates.basis: domains with a readable robots.txt across the whole Tranco frame

asymmetry_headline.basis: domains with a readable robots.txt in the current frame
asymmetry_headline.note: Role tags describe the crawler's stated function. Declared robots.txt policy only; not evidence of intent or of access actually denied.

changes_headline.note: One edition-over-edition comparison, not a trend. Domains entering or leaving the frame are excluded so frame churn is never counted as a policy change.

reachability_headline.note: Reachability of the ranked frame itself. bot_walled = serves robots.txt but refuses an identified crawler at the homepage (403/429): a declared-versus-enforced divergence, not a robots.txt policy.

site_evidence_headline.note: Counts of self-declared, publicly served signals observed on each domain's own homepage. Observations, not classifications.

bazaar_headline.note: Advertised, opt-in acceptance in a public machine-payment registry (x402). Never transactions, volume or revenue. Distinct from Cloudflare pay-per-crawl, which is a different rail that also returns HTTP 402.

frame_provenance.name: CPI-50K v1
frame_provenance.attribution: Tranco (Le Pochat et al., NDSS 2019), custom list Y8V2G; ranking inputs Cisco Umbrella and Majestic (Majestic data CC BY 3.0).

suffix_group_headline.basis: domains with a readable robots.txt, grouped by domain suffix
suffix_group_headline.caveat: A ccTLD is a domain-suffix classification, not a country. It does not indicate operator location, ownership, audience or hosting.

probe_panel_observations.note: Probe-panel counts, never a rate. Declared = robots.txt directive we had already read. Refused = our identified crawler received 4xx/5xx. robots.txt is advisory, so 'declared block, page served' is protocol-normal behaviour and not a failure to comply. Says nothing about how any other crawler behaves — we have no crawler-side logs.

freshness.note: observed=no means the domain did not yield a robots.txt reading in this sweep. Rates are computed over rows_with_reading only.

evidence_summary.crawler_identity: CrawlPriceIndexBot/1.0, self-identified, requests cryptographically signed (RFC 9421 / Web Bot Auth). Public key directory: https://crawlpriceindex.com/.well-known/http-message-signatures-directory

terms: Headline figures free to cite with attribution. Full per-domain data, suffix-group detail and weekly history require a subscription.
license: Headline figures CC-BY-4.0. Full dataset is licensed single-subscriber, redistribution prohibited.
